data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** f8112095ad474c41d08e03d9aa958d126ac1443a
* **Context Scope:** tests/skills/test-sprint-agent-dispatch-pattern.sh vs plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md, plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior
Per plugins/dso/docs/AGENTS.md, registered dso:* agents are dispatched by their named subagent_type with general-purpose as the fallback ("Use dso:<name> directly when registered ... fall back to general-purpose only when not registered"). plugin.json registers dso:gov-copy-writer, dso:completion-verifier, dso:verification-remediation-planner, dso:feasibility-reviewer. A conformance test should therefore accept the named-primary-with-fallback pattern for registered agents.

#### Actual Behavior
tests/skills/test-sprint-agent-dispatch-pattern.sh asserts "no invalid 'subagent_type: dso:*' dispatch pattern" and FAILS (Results: 6 passed, 2 failed) on:
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md — the legitimate named-primary dispatches subagent_type: "dso:gov-copy-writer" (1566, 1603), "dso:completion-verifier" (2311), "dso:verification-remediation-planner" (2389, 2962).
- plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md:308 — subagent_type: "dso:feasibility-reviewer".
The test treats ANY subagent_type: dso:* as invalid, which contradicts the current AGENTS.md named-agent policy and plugin.json registration. Verified PRE-EXISTING: stashing an unrelated edit and re-running yields the identical "6 passed, 2 failed" on the current HEAD.

### 7. Additional Details
Surfaced while validating the sprint-skill audit remediation (Change Sets A/C/D) on branch claude/sprint-skill-audit-gYSHM; not introduced by those edits. This is the concrete manifestation of audit finding F7 (inconsistent dso:* subagent_type guidance). Fix is either updating the test to allow named-primary-with-fallback for registered agents, or aligning the skill files to a single dispatch convention — see related epic 986e-91c5-103e-4118 (command-resolution) is unrelated; F7 should be tracked on its own.
data.title: test-sprint-agent-dispatch-pattern.sh: flags valid dso:* subagent_type -> 2 failing assertions (test stale vs AGENTS.md named-agent policy)
